afterBurst.label: Painted Dome
afterBurst.reason: His Normal Attacks deal Dendro damage only inside Painted Dome, which is when he uses them.

a4Stacks.label: Elemental Mastery from his hits
a4Stacks.reason: Each Normal, Charged or Plunging Attack that hits inside Painted Dome adds 25 Elemental Mastery, up to four stacks, which four hits reach. No swap of the comparison can show it: Elemental Mastery moves damage only through a reaction, and no case of his has one.
